ap_coach_1_guarantee.statement: Insights study-plan output is byte-identical regardless of F3's weaknessCounters writes/reads.
ap_coach_1_guarantee.why_safe: Insights.svelte:34 calls buildStudyPlan(leaks, weakest, minutes, {locale}). `leaks` come from fingerprint.ts over GameAnalysis plies; `weakest` from the radar/weakness dims. NEITHER reads weaknessCounters. coach/program.ts:3 documents the same byte-identity invariant. F3 touches ONLY weaknessCounters (write coach probes into it; read it for trainer selection) — a store the study-plan never consults.
ap_coach_1_guarantee.regression_guard: studyPlan.test.ts determinism test already exists (line 38). F3 adds no change to studyPlan.ts or its inputs.

ap_coach_8_guarantee.statement: Coach diagnostic probes must NOT leak into rating pools (puzzleRating / game pools).
ap_coach_8_guarantee.design: Coach probe recording will write an attempt row + FSRS card + (optionally) weaknessCounters, but will pass the puzzle row UNCHANGED and a model whose puzzleRating is UNCHANGED to the persistence path. gradeAttempt is NOT called for probes-as-rating; the ladder's own rating stays local and is never persisted to puzzleRating.
